kpis.description_fr: Operating Ratio (opex / revenus) - KPI signature des chemins de fer US. Plus bas = meilleur. Class I target ~55-60%.
kpis.description_en: Operating Ratio (opex / revenue) - signature US railroad KPI. Lower is better. Class I target ~55-60%.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Merchandise (agriculture, chemicals, metals, automotive) - 63% du CA railway operating, plus haute marge.
kpis.description_en: Merchandise revenue (agriculture, chemicals, metals, automotive) - 63% of railway operating revenue, highest margin segment.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Intermodal (containers + trailers) - segment dépendant des flux portuaires (importations).
kpis.description_en: Intermodal revenue (containers + trailers) - segment tied to port flows / imports.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Coal - segment en déclin séculaire (transition énergétique), 78.0 millions de tonnes en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Coal revenue - secular decline segment (energy transition), 78.0 million tons in 2025.

kpis.description_fr: Volume total en milliers de carloads (wagons). KPI volume primaire pour US Class I railroads.
kpis.description_en: Total volume in thousands of carloads. Primary volume KPI for US Class I railroads.

kpis.description_fr: Volume Intermodal en milliers d'unités - principal moteur de volume (57% du total).
kpis.description_en: Intermodal volume in thousand units - largest volume driver (57% of total).

kpis_story.description_fr: Plan de redressement opérationnel post-East Palestine + pression Ancora Holdings. Ratio d'exploitation cible <60% en 2025. Mark George CFO depuis 2024.
kpis_story.description_en: Operational turnaround post-East Palestine + Ancora Holdings pressure. Operating ratio target <60% in 2025. Mark George CFO since 2024.

_notes: Excellent railroad disclosure. NS operating ratio improving (64.2% vs Class I best ~55%). Pending merger with Union Pacific announced.
